extracted.name: Whiskey & ginger pitcher
extracted.description: Blend together bourbon, elderflower liqueur and ginger ale to make this vibrant summer cocktail. Garnish with crystallised ginger and mint sprigs to serve
ingredient_lines: crystallised ginger and mint sprigs, to garnish
instruction_lines: Muddle the lime wedges in a large pitcher using a long-handled spoon or muddler.

Tip some ice, the bourbon and elderflower liqueur into the pitcher and top up with ginger ale. Stir well. Thread a few pieces of crystallised ginger onto a cocktail stick and use this to garnish the drink, along with a few sprigs of mint.
